description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work with the robotics team and customers to bring autonomous mobile robots and forklifts from pilot into production. You will lead technical deployments and help integrate robotic fleets into logistics and manufacturing operations.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Install, commission, and map autonomous mobile robots and forklifts at customer warehouses and plants.

 - Integrate robot fleets with warehouse management systems, conveyors, PLCs, and facility infrastructure.

 - Diagnose and resolve hardware, perception, navigation, and fleet software issues in the field.

 - Act as the primary technical contact for customers during pilots and production rollouts.

 - Share field observations and customer feedback with robotics and product teams.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Hands-on experience deploying or integrating robotics, autonomous systems, or industrial automation solutions.

 - Experience leading on-site installation, commissioning, or mapping of autonomous mobile robots or autonomous forklifts.

 - Proficiency in Python and/or C++, experience with Linux, and familiarity with ROS or ROS2.

 - Experience integrating robotic fleets with customer workflows and systems such as warehouse management systems, conveyors, PLCs, or facility infrastructure.

 - Ability to troubleshoot robotic systems in field environments and work directly with customers at warehouses and manufacturing plants.


LOCATION

On-site in New Jersey, United States.
